items.a: Two products in one account, on the same verified domain. Send serves your application's email (sign-ups, password resets, notifications and campaigns) by API, SMTP or MCP, with a dashboard, templates, contacts, broadcasts, webhooks and metrics. Mail gives mailboxes on your domain to people and AI agents. Use one, the other or both.
Visit mepmail.dev, select the correct organization, add a domain you control and complete DNS verification. Then create a key in API Keys with the permissions you need.

items.q: Does adding my domain create an inbox?
items.a: Verification prepares your domain for Sending. Mailboxes are a separate service: registering a mailbox does not automatically change MX or enable receiving. Use the records shown in the dashboard for that domain.

Yes. Use the Send API or connect the MCP from the dashboard. With the mail permissions, the agent reads and drafts only in the mailboxes you choose. You allow direct sending or approve each reply. An agent key on the Mail MCP works too.

items.q: Can I receive email or import Gmail/Hotmail?
items.a: Yes, with MepMail Mail: email inboxes on your domain for people and AI agents. Plans: Solo US$ 2.90/month with 1 mailbox, Duo US$ 5.90 with 3 or Equipe US$ 12.90 with 10; each plan's storage, sends and received messages are shared by its mailboxes, with up to 3 domains (10 on Equipe) and 7 days free with a card, and no Send plan is needed. Each mailbox needs a verified domain with receiving turned on. You can bring older mail over IMAP from your current provider; MBOX/PST files are not imported yet, and Google sign-in does not sync a Gmail inbox.

items.q: What are the prices and limits?
items.a: Send and Mail prices are on the pricing page. Send and Mail have separate licences and quotas, and checkout shows the final price for your organization.

items.q: Sending failed or my email has not arrived. What should I check?
items.a: Check domain verification, key permissions, quotas, suppressions and sending status in the logs. Acceptance or queuing does not prove delivery to the recipient inbox. For diagnosis, provide the time, HTTP status and request or message ID; do not share passwords or keys.

items.q: How do I migrate from Resend?
items.a: Point the official Resend SDKs at MepMail's base URL, swap the API key, and move your domains and contacts. The free account can be migrated with npx @mepmail/cli migrate --from resend. The per-language guide walks through each SDK.

items.q: How do I report abuse or spam?
items.a: Email suporte@mepmail.dev with the message id or the headers. We act on abuse reports, and sending that generates complaints can be paused or the account suspended.

items.q: Do you offer a dedicated IP?
items.a: Not at the moment. Every sender uses Amazon SES's shared IPs, which SES monitors; your reputation comes from your verified domain, your list and your content.

We do not publish a platform-wide delivery rate. Internal MepMail policy, not AWS SES limits: over the rolling last 24 hours (1 elapsed day), new sends pause strictly above 2% hard bounces or 0.08% complaints, with at least 1 confirmed message and 1 corresponding event. Warnings start at 1.5% and 0.05% after 100 confirmed messages in that same window. The warning-only floor never exempts low-volume senders from a pause. Falling below a threshold does not release held mail, reactivate suspended accounts or resume queues; other safety controls still apply.

items.q: My account is under review or suspended. What now?
items.a: We answer within 2 business days. To ask for a review or to appeal, write to suporte@mepmail.dev from the account address with the sending domain, the kind of email you send (transactional, marketing or agents) and where your list comes from. Never send passwords or API keys.

items.q: Is there an SLA or a status page?
items.a: There is no SLA for now. The status page shows the availability of the dashboard, the API and the docs, and the incidents we publish.

close.title: Nothing here answered it?
